datasets.name: reference
datasets.description: terms; TERMS_SOURCE = VENDOR for terms-free bonds

datasets.name: evaluated_prices
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM {database}.{schema}.BOND_PRICES_DAILY WHERE PRICE_DATE BETWEEN :start AND :end

datasets.name: analytics
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM {database}.{schema}.BOND_ANALYTICS_DAILY WHERE AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN :start AND :end

datasets.name: fields
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM {database}.{schema}.BOND_RETURNS_DAILY WHERE AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN :start AND :end
datasets.description: vendor daily total and excess returns (percent)

datasets.name: benchmark_constituents
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM {database}.{schema}.INDEX_CONSTITUENTS WHERE INDEX_CODE = :index_code AND REBALANCE_DATE BETWEEN :start AND :end
datasets.description: index constituents and weights per reconstitution (percent)

datasets.name: ratings
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM {database}.{schema}.RATING_HISTORY WHERE EFFECTIVE_DATE BETWEEN :start AND :end

datasets.name: curves
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM {database}.{schema}.TREASURY_CURVE WHERE CURVE_DATE BETWEEN :start AND :end
